renderings.value: Express a specific point in time or state; 'when', 'just about', or 'in the middle of'.

The ～ところ grammar point is used to describe a specific point in time or stage of action. Depending on the verb tense, it can mean 'just about to do something', 'in the middle of doing something', or 'just did something'.
Verb-casual + ところ, い-Adjective + ところ, な-Adjective + なところ, Noun + のところ
"Right at this point/just about to" - flexible, can mark just-before, during, or just-after a moment.
Stage Of An Action (About To / In The Middle Of / Just Did)
I'm just about to go out.
I'm in the middle of watching a movie.
I plan to have a meal at a good (tasty) place.
He helped me when he himself was busy.
